scope: Add canonical calculation contracts and concise purpose/notes to the five remaining B05 accrual quantity/amount scalars; version increments only; immutable single-catalog installer.

Reversal units use negative commission.sale_amount and sum quantity. Negative total_amount or service fees without commission are explicitly excluded as evidence of product return.

All five contracts retain accrual_date and accruals[].date, require all pages for the requested date, and preserve the existing single-day source semantics.
An empty matching subset is zero only for a complete verified report; missing documents, fields or unfinished pagination cannot be silently treated as zero. Monetary currency checking is required.
New notes are static catalog instructions for concise metric answers with explicit unknown-value preservation. Existing verified selected-root system-note trust boundary is unchanged.
validate_catalog, exact scope verification, canonical expression comparison and Python compilation pass; no new mirror test files or live calls were created.
